meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把原始数据按「Setup-Conflict-Resolution」框架组织成洞察报告,配上可视化建议和业务背景,面向非技术读者,并在结尾给出建议与下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你要向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾或投资者演示,需要把枯燥数据讲成故事时触发。

say.text: 把我这份季度流失数据讲成给高管看的故事
用对比故事帮我分析该先进 EMEA 还是 APAC
say.note: 输出加权评分与推荐结论

say.text: 帮我把月度业务回顾写成一页式数据故事
say.note: 含标题、关键指标与建议

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns raw data into insight reports using the Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative framework, pairing visuals with business context for non-technical readers and ending with recommendations and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you present analytics to executives, build quarterly business reviews or investor decks, or explain data to non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Turn my churn data into a story for executives
Use the comparison story: EMEA or APAC first?
say_en.note: Outputs a weighted scoring matrix and recommendation

say_en.text: Write my monthly review as a one-page data story
say_en.note: Includes headline, key metrics, and recommendations
